scripts.dev: docker compose --env-file .env.development up -d --wait postgres && npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:deploy && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:up && npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.server:up: ssh comercia "cd /opt/comercia && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --wait"
scripts.server:status: ssh comercia "cd /opt/comercia && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps"
scripts.server:logs: ssh comercia "cd /opt/comercia && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f api web migrate"
